meta.name: FX & RISERS
meta.author: MODDYS Foundry
meta.description: Forty-eight own-authored FX and transition presets: open and closing filter sweeps, slow upward risers, instant impacts, dark downlifters and abstract noise-art. Built on the VA voice with its noise source, steep lp24/ladder/band-pass filters (env2 and LFO to cutoff), pitch drift via slow LFO, drive for edge, and the delay and reverb tails that carry the arc. Engine kind va (single-kind routing) across the whole pack; the FX rack supplies edge and space. Full arcs of the longest risers (Tension Riser, Meteor Rise, Spectral Ladder, Final Ascent) run past the 2 s store audition window — audition longer to hear them land; impacts and downlifters complete inside the window.
